title: WHEN NAMES CHANGE VERDICTS: INTERVENTION CONSISTENCY REVEALS SYSTEMATIC BIAS IN LLM DECISION-MAKING

bias_targets.methodology: Intervention consistency testing measuring decision flip rates by counterfactually swapping identity features such as culturally coded names (reflecting race/gender/ethnicity) and stated demographics.

Intervention consistency testing measuring decision flip rates by swapping credential and prestige markers (e.g., institutional affiliations, journal rankings, expert qualifications) while keeping the underlying evidence identical.
Intervention consistency testing measuring decision flip rates by swapping semantically equivalent phrasings with different valences or anchors (e.g., '95% survival rate' vs. '5% mortality rate').
